related.title: POSIX 訊號：合併、遮罩與非同步邊界
related.titleEn: POSIX signals: coalescing, masks and asynchronous boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付位元運算表與路徑權限判讀；ACL、平台差異與管理員特權列為模型外因素。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the bit-mask table and path-permission reasoning; list ACLs, platform differences and administrator privileges outside the model. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 用時間軸列送出、遮罩、pending、解罩及處理時點；以自管pipe通知主迴圈的概念分離工作。
related.differenceEn: Trace send, mask, pending, unblock and handling; conceptually separate work by notifying the main loop through an owned pipe.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
建立時權限是請求模式與遮罩的位元運算，不是十進位相減；檔案與目錄需要不同 execute 語意。
本課數值核對：6*64+4*8+4 = 420 decimal_mode；另一項核對：7*64+5*8+5 = 493 decimal_mode。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

一般訊號的pending狀態不等於可靠事件計數；遮罩期間同類訊號可合併。處理器中只使用規範允許的非同步安全操作。
本課數值核對：min(5,1) = 1 events；另一項核對：5-1 = 4 events。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Creation permissions use a bit mask, not decimal subtraction; execute has different meanings for files and directories.
Numeric audit: 6*64+4*8+4 = 420 decimal_mode; second audit: 7*64+5*8+5 = 493 decimal_mode. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A pending ordinary signal is not a reliable event counter; repeated blocked signals may coalesce. A handler uses only specified async-signal-safe operations.
Numeric audit: min(5,1) = 1 events; second audit: 5-1 = 4 events. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Linux Copy-on-Write：fork 後頁面分離
related.titleEn: Linux copy-on-write: page separation after fork
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付位元運算表與路徑權限判讀；ACL、平台差異與管理員特權列為模型外因素。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the bit-mask table and path-permission reasoning; list ACLs, platform differences and administrator privileges outside the model. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 為每頁列parent-frame、child-frame與refcount；讀操作不改frame，第一次寫才分離。
related.differenceEn: List parent frame, child frame and reference count per page; reads retain sharing, while the first write separates a page.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
建立時權限是請求模式與遮罩的位元運算，不是十進位相減；檔案與目錄需要不同 execute 語意。
本課數值核對：6*64+4*8+4 = 420 decimal_mode；另一項核對：7*64+5*8+5 = 493 decimal_mode。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

fork後可共享唯讀實體頁，寫入時才複製；虛擬映射數增加不等於即時實體複製。
本課數值核對：100*4096 = 409600 B；另一項核對：(100+10)*4096 = 450560 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Creation permissions use a bit mask, not decimal subtraction; execute has different meanings for files and directories.
Numeric audit: 6*64+4*8+4 = 420 decimal_mode; second audit: 7*64+5*8+5 = 493 decimal_mode. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

After fork, read-only physical pages can be shared until a write copies one; more virtual mappings do not imply immediate physical duplication.
Numeric audit: 100*4096 = 409600 B; second audit: (100+10)*4096 = 450560 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
